title: 8-K
主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 per share of common stock for shareholders of record on February 14, 2022, with payment due on March 7, 2022. The announcement was made on February 2, 2022, as part of its regulatory disclosure requirements. The dividend reflects the company's financial position and operational performance for the fourth quarter of 2021 and the full year ending December 31, 2021.
